content.text: Perfect! The fix is working. The issue was floating-point precision: when converting "39.95" to cents, JavaScript calculates `39.95 * 100 = 3995.0000000000005` instead of exactly `3995`. Adding `Math.round()` handles this rounding error. Now 39.95 correctly converts to 3995 cents.
